CuratedThemes_PluginDesc: Adds ten polished light/dark theme pairs — Glacier, Terracotta, Forest, Amethyst, Crimson, Graphite, Indigo, Mint, Champagne and Amber — designed for everyday, practical use.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CuratedThemeProvider: Provides the Glacier, Terracotta, Forest, Amethyst, Crimson, Graphite, Indigo, Mint, Champagne and Amber light/dark theme pairs.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CuratedTranslationProvi: Provides UI localization for the Curated Themes plugin.
